comment:
* Snakes represent a match between two lists. It is optionally prefixed or postfixed with an
     * add or remove operation. See the Myers' paper for details.

variables.name: endX
variables.comment: * End position in the old list, exclusive

variables.name: endY
variables.comment: * End position in the new list, exclusive

variables.name: reverse
variables.comment: * True if this snake was created in the reverse search, false otherwise.

methods.name: Diagonal toDiagonal()
methods.comment:
* Extract the diagonal of the snake to make reasoning easier for the rest of the
         * algorithm where we try to produce a path and also find moves.
